name: hum
description: Work items become Claude Code agent runs, on your Mac or in CI. The repo's own checks decide what they can, a path's risk level decides who reviews, and only what nothing settles becomes a question to you.

pollSeconds.title: Status poll
pollSeconds.description: Seconds between looks at the status file. The view redraws only when the file changed or a shown age changed.

amberAfterSeconds.title: Amber after
amberAfterSeconds.description: Seconds after which a worker's age turns amber. The Mac worker writes the file once per tick.

watchSeconds.title: Watch
watchSeconds.description: Seconds between asks of the work source whether anything changed. One read serves every session in the repo for the engine's watchCacheSeconds.
